Hi Olivia —

Hope you had a good morning. We're excited to get Hightide over the line for the Week‑Zero onboarding. To make the first session productive, can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday?

- Preferred 90‑minute window (we're proposing Tue/Wed 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 13:00–14:30 PT)
- Final attendee list + roles (we'll map to Redwood roles below)
- Any systems we should test access against (SAML/SSO, VPN, or internal dashboards)

I've attached a draft Week‑Zero agenda and a template roster. If those slots look OK, I'll send calendar invites and a single dial-in bundle.

Proposed Redwood staff for the call:
- Connor O'Brien — Technical CSM (lead)
- Monica Patel — Implementation Engineer (tech walkthrough)
- Ben Carter — Customer Reliability (post‑governance)

Attachments: [week0-agenda.pdf (PDF)], [week0-attendee-roster.csv (CSV)]

Thanks — I can be flexible on timing next week.

Connor O'Brien

Thanks Connor — quick response from our side:

- Preferred time: Thu 13:00–14:30 PT works best.
- Attendees: I'll bring Samir (Engineering lead) and Priya Desai (Security lead). Samir will do the SSO overview.
- Systems to test: SAML SSO (Okta), and our staging dashboard (staging.hightidehealth.com).

Also — thanks for the roster template. We'll populate and return by EOD Friday.
